title: Tentacle-shape analysis says the 'jellyfish' are not drifting balloons (compared with Corbell's footage)

tellings.quote: What is interesting about objects of the 7th class, this what we have published images where their tentacles sometimes straight,

plain: Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call UFOs to appear, argues that the floating objects it calls "jellyfish," which have hanging parts like tentacles, are not balloons blowing in the wind. A member of the team who watched them from its field site between 2023 and 2025 tells Michels that in published images of what they call objects of the "7th class," the tentacles are sometimes held straight, which a drifting balloon would not do. They compare this with jellyfish-shaped footage released by the documentary filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, suggesting the objects move under their own control.
